active.name: Plenitude On The Road
active.status: official Spain page publishes exact pay-as-you-go rates by power class (Quick AC <=22 kW 0.39 EUR/kWh; Fast DC <75 kW 0.55 EUR/kWh; Fast+/Ultra Fast DC >=75 kW 0.59 EUR/kWh) plus post-charge occupancy fees. Plenitude also operates its own public charging infrastructure but the app exposes a much larger partner network; do not attach these prices to arbitrary physical CPO aliases until own-network versus roaming eligibility is resolved.

active.name: Mobilize Fast Charge
active.status: Renault/Mobilize confirms deployment into Spain in 2026 and an own ultra-fast network. Official published pricing is launch-window dependent (credit-card launch rate 0.41 EUR/kWh for each station's first two months; Mobilize Charge Pass 0.39 EUR/kWh for one year), so no timeless Spain-wide direct tariff can be integrated without station opening dates or station-specific current pricing.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Official EVcharge/Etecnic material describes a charge-point management SaaS/platform used by municipalities, companies and other operators, with customer-configurable tariffs by time, power and user group. Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

Zunder's official history states that EasyCharger changed its name and image to Zunder in 2022; current legal entity is Grupo Easycharger S.A.
